items.title: Walter "Furry" Lewis Interview, 1967-05-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] But you didn't know Bonham or Egfort or Turnoff? No, no. Those fellas, huh? [INTERVIEWEE] No, no, I did not.

ctx.x: Well, no, I don't. I never did play in big bands like that. Cause they mostly done more traveling than we did. We just was homeless boys around here, certain they didn't go to different places, different parties, different things like that.
But you didn't know Bonham or Egfort or Turnoff? No, no. Those fellas, huh?
No, no, I did not. What about Debbie C. Handy?
